purpose: EVO-A1 of the three-dimension program (docs/readiness/2026-09-05-three-dimension-experiment-program.md sections 4c and 5): the REWARD half of the evolution loop, round 1. The frozen core proposes tool-description rewrites for MF-1's confusable targets on a text-only construction arm; each portfolio is scored by the official scorer on held-out construction rows; best-of-K is kept; four rounds; one read on the sealed 4,000 at the end. This fragment carries only the speech-bearing reward flights, which are baseline-reproduction. The proposer's own text contacts are bounded-discovery-probe and need a SECOND fragment, because a composed experiment fragment declares exactly one execution_plan and therefore exactly one execution profile.
hypothesis: H1: a best-of-K selection over descriptions the frozen core wrote from its own registry rows and block-disjoint construction exemplars produces a registry whose gain survives one read on the sealed 4,000. H2: the deterministic domain+category control is the floor a proposer must clear, and the round-1 length-matched placebo separates form from content. The ceiling is stated before takeoff: under the owner's 2026-09-06 sentinel rule 216 of MF-1's 235 addressable misses sit on directions whose GOLD tool has fold rows, an arithmetic maximum of +5.40 pp on the 4,000. Only 19 rows are unreachable -- 13 whose gold is setBrightness and 6 whose gold is getLightState, both harm sentinels rather than reward tools.

targets.sentinel_rule: A thin tool with u units keeps min(4, u // 2) exemplar units, paid from its smallest blocks, and splits every remaining BLOCK evenly between fold A and fold B as HARM SENTINELS, the odd block to fold A. Its description is rewritten like any other member of its target -- it is the tool the model wrongly reaches for -- but its rows are never reward rows: they leave stage one's slice, they fall to the confirmation's background bound, and any harm on one is named in the round receipt's sentinel_harms line.

evaluation.stage_one: rails.evolution.select_per_target on fold A, per target, gates saves >= 4 / harms <= 1 / net >= 3, winner = largest net then fewer harms then fewer override bytes then lowest k. A COUNT rule: at 6 to 20 rows per tool an interval says nothing.
evaluation.stage_two: rails.evolution.confirm_assembly on fold B: targeted pooled CI90 lower bound strictly above 0 AND background CI90 lower bound at or above -1.0 pp. Accepted as a whole, never partially.
evaluation.intervals: analysis.paired.paired_contrast, 10,000 replicates stratified by tier, seed 20260903, CI90, exact sign test
evaluation.per_round_receipt: rails.evolution.write_round_receipt under docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-06-a2t-evo-a1/; rails.evolution.replay_selection must reproduce every stage-one decision from the sealed per-sample score files alone
mandatory_slices: the evolution curve: round versus fold-A gain, fold-B gain and curve-roster gain
the final paired delta on the 4,000 against the sealed official-protocol outputs, per tier with the arXiv:2604.22821 Table 3 column beside every tier, and per domain
the generalization gap G = delta_foldB - delta_4000 and the transfer ratio delta_4000 / delta_foldB
the named confusion-pair table before and after, per target
the proposer minus the deterministic control, and the proposer minus the placebo, on the same rows
per candidate: six-gram decontamination verdict, exemplar overlap count, rendered token count, per-description character counts

decision.primary: pooled official tool accuracy of the final artifact A* minus the sealed official-protocol baseline, paired over the 4,000
decision.admitted: ADMITTED: the 4,000 CI90 lower bound is above 0, both weightings agree in sign, and the generalization gap is at most half the construction gain
decision.null: NULL: the curve rose but the 4,000 CI includes 0 (reported as overfitting, with the selection rule named), or the curve never rose
kill_results: no target admitted in rounds 1 and 2
a construction gain of at least 2 pp whose 4,000 CI90 includes 0, or a transfer ratio below 0.25
the deterministic control within 0.5 pp of the proposer
the placebo indistinguishable from the proposer candidate
every candidate failing the background tolerance
decision.stop_rule: R_max = 4; stop after two consecutive rejects or an accepted gain under 0.5 pp (rails.evolution.should_stop)
decision.gates_relative_to_the_published_ceiling: the paper column is reported beside every tier as a ceiling reference; no gate is set above it and none relative to it
decision.claim_surface: no superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim. The folds are construction-role discovery rows; the 4,000 are discovery identities already exposed on 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-05; the curve roster's rows are already consumed.
decision.not_authorized: no test contact, no fresh roster, no A2T-FRESH-800 opening, no Q8_0, no second answering model, no parameter update, no edit to an artifact after its fragment was emitted. At most one recovery re-registration per run id.
